notes.title: The Items Update!
notes.content:
Play the game to receive some special items, they are going to your Steam Inventory!
Some of them will be available only in our Christmas Event, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Christmas is here!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

We will have an special event for Soul Climb!

Find your gift inside the game during this event's period, and face a new challenge for extra rewards!

Also, to thank every early adopter, everyone that purchased the game before 1/12 will receive something special!

If you have any doubts or questions, please feel free to ask them here, or send me an e-mail: iamvictorgabler@gmail.com

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: Fixed a small bug in one of the stages.

notes.title: Hotfix Auto Save
notes.content:
Fixed a small issue with the auto save system.

If you have found any bugs or have any improvement suggestions, feel free to send an e-mail to aszudev@gmail.com, or write in a review!
